skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic theoretical knowledge about project appraisal, including concepts, necessity, and roles of project appraisal for different entities in the economy.
Apply theoretical knowledge in practice for project appraisal, including organizing project appraisal tasks, contents to be appraised, and methods to be used during the appraisal process.
Possess the skills and capabilities to apply knowledge to practice project appraisal on real projects.

Have the ability to self-study, accumulate experience to improve professional expertise, and have a sense of responsibility for assigned tasks, cooperate in group work, and adapt to globalization and the 4th Industrial Revolution.
Understand and apply legal requirements in project appraisal.
Evaluate the financial aspects of projects, including capital investment, funding sources, annual revenues and costs, project return rates, cash flows, and financial performance indicators.
Assess the technical and organizational management aspects of projects.
Analyze market conditions and legal aspects of projects.
Identify and manage risks associated with projects.
Collaborate effectively in group work and contribute to group projects.
